verdict.rationale: Temporal's Worker Versioning lets you tag workers and roll out new code paths while old executions keep running on old code (temporal-docs-13/14/29), and community evidence confirms a workflow can be reset to an earlier state and re-run — effectively a rollback (temporal-comm-8). The Web UI/CLI (temporal-gh-2, temporal-probe-3) supports reviewing workflow execution history and state, but this is infrastructure-level versioning of workers/workflow code, not a first-class 'version/review/rollback automations' feature with diffing or audit UI, and community notes documentation gaps around error/anomaly handling (temporal-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback/reset command in official docs, a dedicated review/diff UI for workflow definition changes, and AI-native framing of this capability.
